entries.title: Bitbucket projects now open pull requests
entries.body: When a crewmate finishes work on a Bitbucket project, it now opens a pull request on bitbucket.org instead of only pushing a branch. The merge card reads the builds on its version as its checks. Your click squash-merges it only while the branch is still at that version, and never while Bitbucket reports a conflict, a draft or a rule holding it. If a push lands in the moment Bitbucket merges, it goes in too and the task says so. Projects you already added work this way from their next task.

picture.alt: A merge card for a Bitbucket project: the change's story, Checks passed, pull request #1 on field-notes, and a Merge the pull request button.
